goal: Parse both iNerd essay PDFs into a structured JSON where every entry contains: cleaned question text, cleaned answer text, inferred chapter ID, inferred subject ID, and page reference.
summary: Phase 1 complete. Extracted raw text from both iNerd essay PDFs, wrote a parser that identified Q&A pairs via number/tab questions and y-bullet answers, normalized and deduplicated entries, and produced a structured JSON with 1044 unique essay Q&A entries mapped to inferred chapters and subjects. Deliverables: .kimchi/docs/inerd-essay-part1-raw.txt, .kimchi/docs/inerd-essay-part2-raw.txt, .kimchi/docs/inerd-essays-structured.json, scripts/parse-inerd-essays-v2.py.
stepSummaries:
1. Install/verify PDF extraction tools (pymupdf) and extract raw text from both iNerd essay PDFs [verified]
  2. Write a parser that identifies question/answer pairs, chapter headers, and subject sections within the raw text [verified]
  3. Clean extracted text: normalize whitespace, remove stray PDF artifacts, ensure bullet-point answers are joined into single modelAnswer strings [verified]
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.rationale: All 3 steps verified: raw text extracted (step 1), parser produced structured JSON with all required fields (step 2), cleaning normalized answers and removed duplicates (step 3). Real behavior was exercised end-to-end.
